scientific_integrity: All-length theorem has self-contained combinatorial proof and included reproducible finite checks. The standard of review is same-model only; no external review or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for binary scattered-subsequence minimal-absence spectra of hosts \((0^r1)^k\) with all integers r>=2,k>=1; excludes r=1, other periods, and contiguous factors. Finite verification does not replace the proof. Full bibliographic uniqueness has not been established; a relevant 2023 chapter could not be inspected in full.
title: A run-length invariant and complete minimal-absent-subsequence spectrum for periodic binary words
